title: Bar chart race of the most selling smartphone brands, 2009-2026
subtitle: Annual Unit Shipments from 2009 to 2026
hook: Witness how the global smartphone market shifted over more than a decade of fierce competition.
setup: This animation tracks annual unit shipments for top smartphone brands from 2009 to 2026.

sequence.text: Nokia enters the ranking at the start of the timeline.
Unknown enters the ranking with a notable market share.
Apple overtakes the top position in early 2013.
Samsung takes over the number one spot by mid-2013.
Xiaomi appears as a newcomer in the rankings.
Oppo joins the competition as a newcomer.
Vivo enters the ranking with a strong showing.
Honor appears as a newcomer toward the end of the timeline.

ending: The smartphone landscape transformed dramatically as new contenders reshaped global market share.
